A '''Unidentified Republic commodore''' was the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] command officer of the [[Battle over Korriban|Republic assault on Korriban]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], a conflict with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], alongside the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jerbhen Hulis]]. She guided the fleet meantime the Jedi commanded the grounds forces. She had well utilized informations passed by the rogue [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Exal Kressh]] to take advantage of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy's]] rotation schedule for patrol vessels. The commodore also managed to get her ships past the Empire's [[Ion mine/Legends|ion mine]] field that surrounded [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], allowing for the release of several [[Dropship/Legends|drop-ships]]; these vessels carried [[Republic soldier]]s and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] bound for the surface of the world, where they would attempt to seize the academy and rendezvouz with Kressh within.
